# NetEngineerLab

> Free network engineering calculators, topic hubs and guides for fiber, PON, switching, data-center power and telecom planning. Published in English, Chinese (zh-CN) and Spanish where a translation exists.

Canonical site: https://netengineerlab.com/
Chinese homepage: https://netengineerlab.com/zh/
Spanish homepage: https://netengineerlab.com/es/
Tools directory: https://netengineerlab.com/tools/
Chinese tools directory: https://netengineerlab.com/tools/zh/
Spanish tools directory: https://netengineerlab.com/tools/es/
Topics: https://netengineerlab.com/topics/
Sitemap: https://netengineerlab.com/sitemap.xml

## Languages

Active locales are English (`en`), Chinese (`zh-CN`) and Spanish (`es`). `x-default` is English. A tool or guide has an hreflang alternate only when that locale page exists.
An English tool page is `/tools/{slug}/`. Its Chinese page is `/tools/{slug}/zh/` and its Spanish page is `/tools/{slug}/es/`. Example: `/tools/pon-distance/`, `/tools/pon-distance/zh/`, `/tools/pon-distance/es/`.

## Supplementary tools and workshops

These pages can be indexed. They sit outside the production calculator count above. A language is listed only when that page is published.

- Application Bandwidth Analyzer (en, zh, es): https://netengineerlab.com/tools/application-bandwidth-analyzer/ — Analyzes per-application bandwidth, link utilization and headroom from rates you enter.
- Data Center Architecture Decision Workshop (en, zh, es): https://netengineerlab.com/tools/data-center-architecture-decision-workshop/ — Compares architecture candidates with a local preference rubric, requirement gaps and a migration review.
- IP Camera Network Planner (en, zh, es): https://netengineerlab.com/tools/ip-camera-network-planner/ — Estimates camera bitrate, switch uplinks, PoE budget, NVR storage and N-1 headroom.
- Network Asset Lifecycle Tracker (en, zh, es): https://netengineerlab.com/tools/network-asset-lifecycle-tracker/ — Tracks lifecycle dates, replacement windows and local priorities across device groups.
- OOB Network Design Workshop (en, zh): https://netengineerlab.com/tools/oob-network-design-planner/ — Plans out-of-band transport, console access, management controls and power dependencies.

## Calculator hubs

- PON and fiber calculators: https://netengineerlab.com/tools/pon-fiber-calculators/

- Data center power and cooling calculators: https://netengineerlab.com/tools/datacenter-power-calculators/

Calculator hubs list tools. Topic hubs explain the design and troubleshooting path. They link to each other and do not share a title.

## Usage notes

Calculations are engineering aids. Validate assumptions, vendor specifications, standards and field conditions before deployment.
